استجنست (form X)

# اِسْتَجْنَسْتَ (istajnasta) /is.tad͡ʒ.nas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اِسْتَجْنَسْتِ (istajnasti) /is.tad͡ʒ.nas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# اِسْتَجْنَسَتْ (istajnasat)
